correctness.rationale: Reconstructed labelled K_n forest ensemble as all acyclic edge subsets and checked DSU cycle predicate exhaustively for n3..6. Recomputed sums 7,38,291,2932 and all 2^15 six-vertex signed Walsh multipliers with exact integer FWHT. Obtained 3105 zeros in 10 vertex-relabelling orbits; support histogram {5:180,7:1080,9:1800,11:45}, unique minimal 5-edge orbit rep662 of paw disjoint K2. Full set has 49 signed levels with gcd and smallest nonzero magnitude4; rank29663, Moore–Penrose norm 1/4, max2932, condition733. Hadamard range-support kernel L1 integer numerator 1210058 over 32768 gives sharp orthogonal projection endpoint 605029/16384. Finite exhaustive mask computation plus independent orbit enumeration does not infer n>=7.
